From: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@acmelabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmelabs.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: APAC hosting assurance and private endpoint separation request

Hi Naomi,

We're working through our SIG/CAIQ and need a formal confirmation from Redwood about APAC hosting and VPC/private endpoint separation for our pilot. Specifically:

- Can you confirm that inference requests for Acme Labs can be served only from APAC regions (ap-southeast-1 / ap-northeast-2) and that logs/keys will not egress to other regions?
- Do you support customer-managed KMS (separate partitioning) for private deployments?
- We'd like details on private endpoint architecture: VPC peering vs PrivateLink, IP ranges, and whether there is any cross-region fallthrough for failover.
- Please attach any CAIQ/SIG/SOC 2 evidence that maps to data residency and network isolation controls.

Timeline: we'd like the evidence and a short attestation letter by EOD next Thursday (6/3) to progress procurement.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Tan
Security & Privacy Lead
Acme Labs
sarah.tan@acmelabs.com

Attachment: acmelabs_sig_questions.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@acmelabs.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC hosting assurance and private endpoint separation request

Hi Sarah,

Thanks — happy to help. Short answers up front, followed by attachments and next steps.

- APAC-only serving: Yes. For Private deployments and Dedicated customers we can pin model serving to APAC regions (we currently validate ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-2). Tokens and inference traffic will be routed to the customer-designated region and will not be routed to other regions unless you opt into cross-region failover. We include region-locked prefixes and routing policies in the deployment config.

- KMS partitioning: Supported for Private deployments (customer-managed KMS). We can provide a diagram and keyflow doc; keys remain under your KMS or can be isolated into a per-tenant key space.

- Private endpoint topology: We support both VPC peering and PrivateLink/Private Endpoint depending on cloud provider. For peering we provide recommended CIDR ranges and a peering runbook; for PrivateLink we supply a managed endpoint with no transitive routing. Cross-region failover is opt-in and requires an agreed fallback policy (we can limit to read-only fallbacks if needed).

Attachments included:
- redwood_apac_hosting_declaration.pdf (hosting-attestation)
- redwood_caiaq_sig_summary.xlsx (mapping of CAIQ/SIG to our controls)
- redwood_soc2_aoc_2025.pdf (SOC 2 AOC summary)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the specific APAC region you prefer and whether you require cross-region failover.
2) We'll prepare a short attestation letter signed by our compliance lead and share via DocuSign—target for 2 business days after confirmation.
3) For technical onboarding, Jonas will coordinate the peering runbook and Kimberly will own the KMS/keyflow questions.

Jonas/Kimberly — looping you in for technical notes and to confirm we can deliver the attestation in the timeline.

Regards,

Naomi Feldman
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood_apac_hosting_declaration.pdf; redwood_caiaq_sig_summary.xlsx; redwood_soc2_aoc_2025.pdf
